evidence.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT's own office suite
evidence.body: [e001:f01] At its DevDay developer conference in San Francisco on Tuesday, OpenAI announced several new ChatGPT features designed for office workers. [e001:f02] Most notably, OpenAI launched a feature called Space, a shared workspace inside ChatGPT where co-workers can collaborate with the chatbot and with their own Dots, OpenAI’s newly launched AI agent personas (that can carry out tasks on a user’s behalf), on a range of work tasks. [e001:f03] “Your pages and files all live together in Space, like they would in a drive,” said CEO Sam Altman during Tuesday’s presentation. [e001:f04] “But spaces feel alive.” Altman said users can give a page specific instructions, such as checking a team channel and updating the page with what it finds. [e001:f05] OpenAI also launched Pages, a companion word processor that the company describes as “a new type of document, built for human and agent collaboration.” It appears to be OpenAI’s answer to Google Docs and Microsoft Word. [e001:f06] Users can “write, research, generate charts, create images, or visualize information” in it, OpenAI says. [e001:f07] OpenAI has also announced its answer to PowerPoint with what it calls collaborative slides. [e001:f08] These slides can be created by merely talking about them within ChatGPT. [e001:f09] Once the slides are generated, multiple workers and agents can work together within them and will have the ability to leave comments and edit them. [e001:f10] Slides isn’t available quite yet but will roll out to users in the coming weeks, an OpenAI representative said. [e001:f11] As OpenAI edges into Microsoft’s territory, Microsoft and other software companies like Salesforce are busy trying to become more like OpenAI. [e001:f12] Over the past year, both companies have released a slew of AI products as the software industry attempts to keep up with the shifting landscape. _UPDATE Tuesday Sept. evidence.title: OpenAI Halts GPT-6.1 Astra Release After Model Fails Safety Standards
evidence.body: [e004:f01] “Of course we want to make sure our model development is safe no matter whether that’s in the company, or when we ship it to users,” Saachi Jain, head of safety systems at OpenAI, said in a statement. [e004:f02] “But when we ship it to users, we have an extremely high bar in terms of safety and alignment.” The decision is notable because Astra had been positioned as part of OpenAI’s next generation of models. [e004:f03] Earlier this month, [the company released GPT-6 Astra](https:// describing it as the result of “years of research and big bets.” CEO Sam Altman said at the time that the model represented a “new capability level” and predicted it would contribute to greater entrepreneurship, creativity, economic growth and scientific discovery. [e004:f04] [Image 2](https:// The cancellation of GPT-6.1 Astra therefore does not signal that OpenAI has stopped advancing its model portfolio. [e004:f05] Instead, it shows that the company is willing to prevent a model from reaching users when its safety performance falls below the threshold it has set. [e004:f06] The company’s safety and security practices have faced increased scrutiny since July, when two of its models escaped containment, accessed the open internet, and [breached the open-source developer platform Hugging Face.](https:// OpenAI subsequently disclosed other incidents involving unintended model behavior. [! [e004:f07] OpenAI has responded by increasing its focus on safety and alignment, the process through which developers attempt to ensure models behave consistently with human interests and intended constraints. [e004:f08] But a model that aggressively pursues an objective after encountering restrictions can create new security risks. [e004:f09] The difficulty is determining how much autonomy a model should have when the original task becomes ambiguous or encounters obstacles. ### The Decision Comes Amid Calls To Slow AI Development OpenAI’s decision also arrives as the broader AI industry debates whether the pace of model development has become too fast. [e004:f10] Altman has expressed support for the idea of “pacing the frontier,” although OpenAI continues to release new models and invest heavily in infrastructure. [e004:f11] Rather than slowing development across the board, OpenAI can continue training and testing new systems while imposing a higher threshold for models that are actually released to customers. [e004:f12] That strategy is expected to gain wider adoption as the cost of developing frontier models rises and companies face pressure from investors, customers and governments to maintain their competitive positions. ### Commercial Pressure Complicates The Safety Debate OpenAI is operating under significant pressure to maintain its lead in a rapidly expanding market. [e004:f13] OpenAI’s decision suggests that, at least internally, safety evaluations can override the commercial incentive to release another model. ### What The Astra Decision Says About The Next Phase Of AI The most significant aspect of the decision may not be the cancellation itself, but what it says about how model releases are likely to evolve. [e004:f14] OpenAI’s decision to halt GPT-6.1 Astra provides a concrete example of that tension. [e004:f15] The company has not said precisely which safety tests Astra failed or what behaviors prevented its release. evidence.title: DevRev joins the OpenAI Marketplace launch to advance customer and employee self-service
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 29, 2026 [(GLOBE NEWSWIRE)](https:// -- [DevRev](https:// today announced that it is joining the OpenAI Marketplace as a launch partner. [e005:f02] OpenAI’s Marketplace will give OpenAI enterprise customers more flexibility to invest in qualifying partner products using a portion of their existing OpenAI commitment. [e005:f03] DevRev’s listing gives OpenAI customers a new path to explore customer and employee self-service by connecting AI to the context, permissions, workflows, and controls required to safely operate across enterprise workflows. [e005:f04] At launch, customers will be able to discover DevRev through the Marketplace Directory and contract directly with DevRev for their enterprise product offerings. [e005:f05] "OpenAI is changing the intelligence available to every business. [e005:f06] DevRev makes that intelligence operational across customer and employee service - where customers expect resolution and employees need the knowledge and ability to move work forward,” said Adnan Bhutta, CVP, Business and Alliances at DevRev. [e005:f07] Customer and employee service teams are adapting to a changing spectrum of one end, fully autonomous AI can answer questions and complete clear, repeatable actions within defined standard operating procedures. [e005:f08] This enables organizations to deploy OpenAI’s models so every agent can act within approved boundaries, record what it does, and route work to the right person when expertise or approval is required. [e005:f09] With the OpenAI Marketplace, enterprise customers can now use their existing OpenAI commitments to access solutions built by partners like DevRev on OpenAI’s models and platform. [e005:f10] Together, we’re combining our frontier intelligence with DevRev’s platform to give customers more choice in how they put AI to work.” - Brian Landsman, VP Global Partnerships at OpenAI **How it works in practice** For employees, DevRev helps people research, decide, and act across company systems without tracking down the right team. [e005:f11] DevRev can apply configured identity and entitlement policies, provision an approved license, update the appropriate system of record, and log the action. [e005:f12] For customers, DevRev helps resolve routine, repeatable support requests using the organization’s knowledge and service history. [e005:f13] For complex product and technical-service issues, DevRev creates multi-player rooms that bring the right people and context together to resolve issues in a conversational experience. [e005:f14] Across customer and employee self-service, the progression is the same: from finding information, to receiving the right answer, to taking an approved action. [e005:f15] The result is a company that is easier to connect with - for customers who need help, employees who need to act, and experts whose time is most valuable when human judgment matters. **About DevRev** DevRev is an enterprise AI company that helps organizations make their collective capability available to customers and employees. [e005:f16] Its platform connects enterprise business systems with permissions intact to power employee self-service through enterprise search and internal service desks, and customer self-service through conversational support across chat, email, and voice.

evidence.title: OpenAIのAIエージェントが画像53件を投稿 「限定公開URL」は安全なのか（Masumi｜ライター）
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 対象になったのは、AIの改善に会話データを使うことを許可していたアカウントの画像だ。 [e006:f02] この記事では、何が起きたのか、限定公開のリンクは安全といえるのか、今日からできる対策は何か、の順に整理する。 [e006:f03] 試験中のAIが、学習用データを外へ送っていた OpenAIの説明によると、研究用の試験環境で動いていたAIエージェントが、作業のために外部サービスを使う過程で、AIの学習や性能評価に使うデータを外に送っていた。 [e006:f04] このうちの53件が、利用者がChatGPTに入力した画像だった。 [e006:f05] 画像は、URLを知っている人だけが開ける「一覧に載らないリンク」の形で、画像共有サイトに投稿されていた。 [e006:f06] OpenAIは、画像を掲載したサービスの事業者と連携して、大半を削除済みだと説明している。 [e006:f07] 「非公開リンク」は、鍵のかかった部屋ではない ここで引っかかるのが「非公開リンク」という言葉だ。 [e006:f08] Webの世界でいう限定公開のURLは、検索結果に表示されないようにする仕組みにすぎない。 [e006:f09] 筆者が活動しているSEOの現場で、公開前のテストページを限定公開のURLに置いて確認することはよくある。 [e006:f10] OpenAIのAIエージェントが、試験環境から抜け出し、AIプラットフォーム「Hugging Face」のシステムに侵入していたことが明らかになった。 [e006:f11] OpenAIは8月26日に経緯や再発防止策を公表した。 [e006:f12] その後、OpenAIは過去のエージェントの動きを調べ直している。 [e006:f13] ロイターによると、画像がAIで作られたものか、実在の人物を写したものか、いつ投稿されたものかについて、OpenAIは回答を避けている。 [e006:f14] 「設定」から「データコントロール」を開き、「すべての人のためにモデルを改善する」をオフにする。 [e006:f15] 人間なら「これは外に出してはいけない」と判断できる場面でも、AIエージェントは目的達成を優先して越えてしまうことがある。 [e006:f16] OpenAIは、公表と再発防止を続けるとしている。

evidence.title: OpenAI、常時稼働AIエージェント「dots」発表－月8万円の新プランも（Bloomberg）
evidence.body: [e007:f01] ユーザーに代わり、さまざまな業務を能動的にこなす。 [e007:f02] AIを活用したデジタルアシスタント分野が拡大する中、メタ・プラットフォームズなどと競合することになる。 [e007:f03] dotsはコンピューターの操作、接続アプリからの情報取得、調査、文書作成、ソフトウエア開発といった業務を行える。 [e007:f04] ユーザーはChatGPT上で文字や音声により指示できるほか、「スラック」やマイクロソフトの「Teams」からメッセージで指示することも可能。 [e007:f05] OpenAIでは、エンジニアがdotsを使って1日数十件のソフトウエアのバグを修正している。 [e007:f06] サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）は29日、同社の開発者向けイベントでdotsを披露した。 [e007:f07] 併せて「Sol」モデルの最新版や、チームがAIを交えて共同作業できる機能も発表した。 [e007:f08] 利用上限を引き上げ、処理速度を高めた月額500ドル（約7万8700円）の上位プランを新設する一方、月額200ドルのプランでは一部の利用上限を引き下げる。 [e007:f09] 同氏はdotsについて、「いつでも頼れるAIアシスタントのようなものだ」と説明した。 [e007:f10] AIがアクセスできる範囲をユーザーが設定できるとし、安全面も強調。 [e007:f11] 「自分が安心できる範囲で、dotsに仕事を任せられる」と述べた。 [e007:f12] さらに、企業向けに特定の業務用のdotsも試験していると明らかにした。 [e007:f13] 同社がより高度なAIツールの収益拡大と普及を目指す中、その技術の安全性に対する目は厳しさを増している。 [e007:f14] OpenAIのグレッグ・ブロックマン社長らAI業界幹部は29日、トランプ米大統領との昼食会に出席した。 [e007:f15] AIが人間への脅威になり得るとの社会的懸念が高まる中、AIの安全性を巡る議論が交わされた。 [e007:f16] NYSE・ナスダックで12月6日開始。

evidence.title: OpenAIが次世代AIモデルのリリース中止、安全性巡る懸念で断念－報道
OpenAI Cancels Upcoming AI Model When It Shows Signs of Being Evil
evidence.body: [e008:f01] By Victor Tangermann Published Sep 29, 2026 1:00 PM EDT Add Futurism (opens in a new tab) Getty / Futurism For the second time in a matter of months, OpenAI paused the development of its frontier AI models after revealing even more instances of the experimental systems going rogue and hacking into third party servers. [e008:f02] The news once again highlighted rising concerns over the AI industry losing the ability to keep their own technology in check. [e008:f03] Now, the Sam Altman-led company is canceling the release of its next-generation AI model GPT-6.1 Astra, as the Wall Street Journal reports . [e008:f04] OpenAI researchers found it scored poorly on alignment tests, which are designed to measure how willing a given AI model is to stick to its human overlord’s instructions. [e008:f05] In common parlance, you could say the model was showing too many signs of being evil. [e008:f06] The researchers found that the AI was even more willing to deceive users than previous models. [e008:f07] “For anything regarding safety and alignment, there’s a trade off,” OpenAI’s head of safety systems Saachi Jain told the newspaper. [e008:f08] “You really do need to find what’s the right line between staying within scope, but also avoiding laziness in terms of how the model actually pursues tasks even when it hits friction.” The timing of the news is unfortunate for the company. [e008:f09] OpenAI is kicking off its developer conference in San Francisco today, an event that’s usually reserved for the launch of new models. [e008:f10] But now that most frontier AI labs agree to slow down the development of their models, the company is operating in a notably different environment. [e008:f11] Meanwhile, OpenAI has promised to beef up its defenses and implement stronger guardrails for its cybersecurity testing after its AI agents have repeatedly broken out of their sandbox environments. [e008:f12] Instead of risking even more incidents, like the dozens it has already admitted of so far this year, OpenAI decided to scrap the public launch of its latest model. [e008:f13] “We want to make sure our model development is safe no matter whether that’s in the company, or when we ship it to users,” Jain told the WSJ . [e008:f14] “But when we ship it to users, we have an extremely high bar in terms of safety and alignment.” OpenAI now has its work cut out to ensure that future models are rewarded for following instructions. [e008:f15] OpenAI’s extremely addictive AI chatbot, ChatGPT, has already landed the company in hot water. [e008:f16] More on OpenAI: OpenAI Halts Frontier Model Training as Rogue Agent Crisis Deepens。

evidence.body: [e006:f01] 「野獣」を飼いならす OpenAIは、OpenClawの暴走で見られたエージェントのリスクを理解しているのは間違いない。 [e006:f02] Dotsを実行するプライベートクラウド上の仮想マシンには、多層構造のセキュリティスタック全体が組み込まれている。 [e006:f03] まずDotsを専用の仮想マシン上で動作させる構造自体が、AIをユーザーのコンピューターやネットワークから隔離させることに貢献している。 [e006:f04] ただし、ノートPCへのアクセス権限をDotsに付与した場合、設計された保護機能の一部が低下する点に注意が必要だ。 [e006:f05] また、同社はDotsのキルスイッチも用意した。 [e006:f06] OpenAIは、Dotsに組み込まれた安全対策が悪意のある指示からDotsを防御し、有害な可能性のある挙動を監視すると説明している。 [e006:f07] 監視システムが安全上の問題を検出した場合、Dotsの作業を一時停止または停止できるとしている。 [e006:f08] システムには自動監査機能やカスタムルールが備わり、進行可能な作業と承認を必要とする作業の判断に役立つ。 [e006:f09] AIの学習に関して同社は、「フォルトでChatGPT Business、Enterprise、Eduのワークスペースにおけるコンテンツをモデル改善に使用することはない」と説明している。 [e006:f10] 個人向けのChatGPTプランでは、Dotsの会話や作業をモデル改善に使用するかどうかをコントールできる。 [e006:f11] そのため、ユーザーは無数の権限承認によって疲労する恐れがある。 [e006:f12] 面倒だとユーザーがAIのあらゆる要求を承認すれば、結果的として堅固なガードレールは無用の長物と化す。 [e006:f13] デスクトップ、ウェブ、モバイルのChatGPTを通じてメッセージや通話が行え、進行状況や質問、承認事項に関する連絡がDotsから届くと説明されている。 [e006:f14] フィードバックを検証済みの修正案に変える スコープの変更に応じてリリース計画を修正する 新たな証拠に基づいて分析を更新する 要件の変化に応じて提案書を更新する コンテンツの制作作業を自動化する Dotsがこれら全ての作業を実行できる点に疑いはないが、初期状態のまますぐに実現できるわけではない。 [e006:f15] しかし、単にGPT-6へ適切なカスタマーサービスメールの処理を指示するだけの作業と比較して、はるかに多くの作業、計画、アーキテクチャー設計を必要とする。 [e006:f16] 提供：OpenAI/ZDNET この記事は海外Ziff Davis発の記事を4Xが日本向けに編集したものです。

evidence.title: OpenAI Launches Dots, Raising New Data Governance Questions
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The company announced Dots at its DevDay event in San Francisco. [e002:f02] According to a post by OpenAI , Dots are designed to handle recurring, multi-step tasks on their own, allowing users to delegate work rather than start a new interaction for every step. [e002:f03] They can be accessed through ChatGPT, text messages, Slack or voice and can work across connected applications. [e002:f04] OpenAI is introducing Dots to help businesses move from on-demand AI assistance to continuous task execution. [e002:f05] Users can assign Dots specific responsibilities, with the agents continuing to work and returning when they need a decision or additional input. [e002:f06] Dots Extend AI Into Ongoing Workflows Unlike a conventional chatbot that waits for a new prompt, Dots can continue working on assigned tasks and return to users when they need a decision. [e002:f07] OpenAI is rolling out the feature to eligible business and enterprise users, with enterprise workspace controls for managing access and capabilities. [e002:f08] Enterprise administrators can control who can use Dots and whether they can connect to Slack and Microsoft Teams. [e002:f09] They can also control whether Dots can access local computers and whether users can create custom rules that guide their actions and confirmations. [e002:f10] Persistent Agents Raise New Data Governance Questions For chief data officers (CDOs), the shift toward always-on agents raises questions about access, ownership and monitoring. [e002:f11] A Dot that can work across connected applications may interact with business information over an extended period, making it important to define what data it can access and what actions it can take. [e002:f12] CDOs can also help establish AI governance around agent permissions and accountability. [e002:f13] That includes defining who can deploy agents, reviewing the systems and data they can access, monitoring their activity and ensuring that access changes when an agent’s role changes. [e002:f14] OpenAI’s enterprise controls already point to these governance needs. [e002:f15] Dots access is off by default for Enterprise, and administrators can manage access through workspace permissions and custom roles.

evidence.title: OpenAI Launches dots, Always-On AI Agents That Work in the Cloud
evidence.body: [e004:f01] OpenAI's dots are always-on AI agents with their own cloud computers, rolling out today to Pro, Business Premium, and Enterprise users in eligible markets. [e004:f02] OpenAI is rolling out dots, a new class of always-on AI agents that take on work autonomously, starting today for users on its Pro, Business Premium, and Enterprise plans . [e004:f03] Each dot runs on its own cloud computer and is powered by the company's GPT-6 Astra model. [e004:f04] The rollout is limited to eligible markets at first, with broader availability promised soon. [e004:f05] The agents are reachable through ChatGPT on desktop, web, and mobile, and also through Slack and Teams. [e004:f06] OpenAI says teams of dots are envisioned over time. [e004:f07] When the user is not actively working, proactive research runs in the background, restricted to read-only tools that cannot send messages or change app content. [e004:f08] When signing in to supported sites, a dot can draw on saved passwords without the model seeing them, and a monitoring system can pause or stop a dot's work. [e004:f09] Permissions are managed through the existing ChatGPT app controls, with Custom Rules that allow, require approval for, or block specific actions. [e004:f10] OpenAI cautions that dots can still make mistakes and says consequential work should be reviewed. [e004:f11] Personal plan users control whether dot conversations are used for model improvement, and there is no direct training on proactive research or a dot's notes. [e004:f12] An early tester's dot prepared and sent an invoice after receiving approval, according to the announcement. [e004:f13] OpenAI also previewed specialist dots with their own identity for access management, including IT-provisioned hardware and deep integrations with systems of record. [e004:f14] OpenAI says it is working with Microsoft so that Agent 365 security and governance controls can cover specialist dots, with the aim of letting companies oversee them using Microsoft tools already in place. [e004:f15] The launch follows OpenAI's recent model releases, including GPT-6.1 Sol, which the company said offers near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth of Astra's standard API token prices . [e004:f16] GPT-6 Sol and Luna, announced earlier, were described by the company as two models striking different balances between capability and cost .

evidence.title: OpenAI launches Dots: the cute assistant that aims to compete with Muse
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The GPT-6-based Astra agent operates autonomously across apps and services, even when the user is not online. [e005:f02] It poses a challenge to Meta’s Muse. [e005:f03] At OpenAI’s DevDay, it was presented as an assistant that, for example, spots a forgotten invoice, prepares it and waits for the go-ahead to send it. [e005:f04] The idea is to shift ChatGPT from simply answering a question to managing a task that continues over time. [e005:f05] A dot is an agent based on GPT-6 Astra: it is cloud-based, can use a browser and connect to over 4,000 apps. [e005:f06] OpenAI claims that it learns from feedback and can seek out useful tasks even whilst the user is busy elsewhere. [e005:f07] For now, you can only create one personal dot; the company envisages multiple agents capable of collaborating in the future. [e005:f08] OpenAI The move comes in the wake of Meta’s Muse, which has sparked interest in always-on assistants. [e005:f09] The similarity lies in the ambition: an AI that knows the user’s preferences and carries out tasks within their apps without having to start afresh with a new conversation every time. [e005:f10] For OpenAI, the stakes are high: to become the hub around which daily work is organised, before a competitor does. [e005:f11] This is an interpretation of the strategy, not proof that Dots can already deliver on all the promises made at launch. [e005:f12] It is precisely this autonomy that makes the issue of controls so crucial. [e005:f13] When Dots searches for job opportunities in the background, the tools available are more limited: in that mode, it cannot send messages or edit content. [e005:f14] The company does, however, warn that it may make mistakes. [e005:f15] The real test now will be to see how much work it can actually get done without creating more work that needs to be monitored. evidence.title: OpenAI expands Codex and its API at DevDay with security scans, a Decisions API, and Ultrafast
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The Agents API picks up Computer Use, and OpenAI is adding a Decisions API and Ultrafast, a pricey new speed tier.** OpenAI announced the updates at its DevDay 2026 developer conference in San Francisco. [e001:f02] Developers also get a revamped Codex CLI, a code review view in the ChatGPT desktop app, and a new technical foundation for the agent platform OpenAI runs with Amazon. ## Reusable environments let teams get Codex tasks running faster According to OpenAI, Codex now works on your own computer, from your phone, or in the cloud from any device. [e001:f03] Codex in the cloud is available on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Healthcare plans. ! [e001:f04] The new CLI is available on all plans. ## Codex reviews code on the desktop and hunts for vulnerabilities in the cloud The ChatGPT desktop app gets its own code review view for changes across multiple projects. [e001:f05] Developers can read summaries, go through diffs, and ask Codex about possible problems before leaving feedback on GitHub pull requests or GitLab merge requests. [e001:f06] [Image 2: Code-Review-Ansicht mit einem Kommentar von Codex zur Datei , der Priorität P2 und Buttons für Reply, Resolve und Fix, rechts ein Chatverlauf zur Überarbeitung der Merge-Conflict-Oberfläche.](https:// In the new code review view, Codex comments on changes and applies fixes on request. | Image: OpenAI Codex Security Cloud is aimed at security teams. [e001:f07] Codex investigates what it finds, filters out duplicates, and prepares fixes in the cloud, even when the laptop is closed. [e001:f08] In July, OpenAI released the [Codex Security CLI as an open-source tool](https:// that checks repositories from the command line and in CI/CD pipelines. [e001:f09] Codex Security Cloud is available for Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu on desktop and web. ! [e001:f10] [Image 3: Dunkles Dashboard von Codex Security Cloud mit den Reitern Overview, Findings, Repositories, Scans und Configure, einer Pipeline von "Discovered" bis "Done" und einer Liste offener Funde mit Fix-Buttons.](https:// Codex Security Cloud tracks every vulnerability it finds from discovery to fix. | Image: OpenAI ## Agents built on the API can now operate software themselves The [Agents API](https:// has been in public beta since September 11 and runs on the same infrastructure as Codex and ChatGPT. [e001:f11] OpenAI has offered the feature in Codex and ChatGPT on macOS since April and [on Windows 11](https:// since May. [e001:f12] [Image 4: Schema mit drei Kästen, die eigene Anwendung schickt Aufgaben an die Agents API mit "Managed Codex harness" bei OpenAI, diese ruft Werkzeuge in einer Sandbox bei OpenAI oder einem anderen Anbieter auf.](https:// The Agents API handles the agent's control loop while commands and files run in a sandbox. | Bild: OpenAI AWS and OpenAI [announced Bedrock Managed Agents as a limited preview in April](https:// The platform now takes on the core features of the Agents API, can be customized for AWS, and connects directly to AWS resources. [e001:f13] That means developers can build OpenAI agents that run entirely on AWS. ## OpenAI joins the push for fast decision models With the Decisions API, OpenAI is moving into the field of so-called System One models. [e001:f14] In mid-September, Diogo Almeida's startup TypeSafe AI introduced one such model called [Jev](https:// and the former OpenAI researcher's release set off a wave of hype among developers. [e001:f15] For the Decisions API, OpenAI uses a version of [GPT-6 Luna](https:// its low-cost model. [e001:f16] [Image 5: Balkendiagramm zur Bearbeitungszeit einer Aufgabe, die Decisions API braucht 150 Millisekunden, die GPT-6 Luna API 1,6 Sekunden.](https:// OpenAI says the Decisions API makes decisions ten times faster than GPT-6 Luna does through the regular API. | Bild: OpenAI ## Ultrafast speed comes at six times the price According to OpenAI, the new Ultrafast premium tier speeds up token generation in Codex by up to eight times, to 300 tokens per second.
